paragraphs: For recording, position microphones and test sound to find the best pickup angle. Then mix the session, layering vocals, drums, and bass and adjusting EQ and space so parts do not conflict. Live performances are more intense, with faders moving during the show to suppress feedback and imbalances. Finally, mastering unifies loudness across the album.
